evidence.locator: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/ExamplePolicies_AEB.md :: The following policy gives users permissions for all actions required to use Elastic Beanstalk. This policy also allows Elastic Beanstalk to provision and manage resources on your behalf in the following services.
